_readme: Per-fixture broadcast overrides, keyed by fixture id (the club feed's gameId; it is the `id` field in /fixtures). Use for ITV free-to-air PREM picks and for televised PREM Cup games. `channels: []` means confirmed NOT televised. Merged with env BROADCAST_OVERRIDES (JSON, same shape), which wins. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

294854.note: PREM Cup opener, Bristol v Gloucester, 5 Sep 2026
